tip: Volerci means it takes (time). Its past uses essere, so voluti agrees with giorni, masculine plural.
Formal Lei commands use the subjunctive form, so lasciare becomes lasci, not the informal lascia.
In a meno che non ci sia, the non is pleonastic, not a real negation: it means unless there is traffic.
Il che points back to the whole previous statement, not a single noun, which is why significa follows it.
